text:
Ashley Park: Hey team — I accepted the GitHub org invite but when I go to the repo it says I'm an "Outside collaborator" and I don't see the infra or platform teams. CI for my PR is failing with "permission denied".
Ida - People Ops: Sorry about that, Ashley. Can you confirm the email you used to accept the invite?
Ashley Park: I accepted with my personal GH account (ashley.dev@gmail.com) because I didn't realize I needed to claim the work account. My work account is ashley@redwood.com
Ida - People Ops: Ah — that's the issue. SSO maps org membership to your work email. I'll re-send the invite to ashley@redwood.com. Do you have 2FA enabled on that account?
Ashley Park: Yes 2FA enabled. I tried switching, but GitHub keeps asking to complete SSO and then errors out: "SAML provisioning failed".
onboard-bot: Note: SSO provisioning can take up to 5 minutes after re-invite.
Julian: @Ida @Ashley can you try this quick check from your local machine to see which account GitHub thinks you're on:
```
# open profile page
open https://github.com/settings/profile
# OR check via gh
gh auth status
```
Ashley Park: gh auth status shows I'm logged into ashley.dev@gmail.com (GitHub.com) and 'no SSO token' for redwood org.
Carter: If you can switch accounts in the browser (sign out, then sign in to ashley@redwood.com), that usually clears the SSO prompt. If that fails I'll escalate to IT to re-provision SAML link.
Ida - People Ops: I've resent invite to ashley@redwood.com and added them to the "engineers/platform" team. You should get an email. LMK when accepted.
Ashley Park: Accepted — now shows me as a member and I can see infra/ci config. CI still errors with: "remote: You don't have permission to create a status for this repository" on push.
Julian: That sounds like repo-level permissions. @Carter can you check the repo team access? Might need "triage" or "write" for the platform team on the repo.
Carter: Just updated the team perms — platform team now has Write on repo/redwood/runtime. Try again.
Ashley Park: Pushed and CI jobs started. Thank you! :tada:
Ida - People Ops: Welcome aboard again! Ping here if anything else blocks you.
Ashley Park: Will do. Appreciate the quick help everyone.
